title: S04T05 - Ship review queues, merge status, and lifecycle end-to-end coverage
description: Expose review and merge state in CLI, console, dashboards, handoffs, and fixtures spanning implementation, changes requested, re-review, approval, merge, and failure recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Humans and agents can see pending reviews, assigned reviewers, rounds, findings, approvals, merge readiness, and recovery commands from shared view models.
End-to-end tests cover self-review refusal, stale approval, requested changes, approved merge, conflict, interruption, resume, rollback, and cleanup.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
